space_filter.chunk_reads: space_id plus revision filters return no rows across spaces
space_filter.dense_search: Qdrant payload filter returns only the requested space
space_filter.override_reads: repository and audit fallback are both space scoped
space_filter.index_pointers: one active pointer row per space; cross-space FK writes are rejected

index_switch_and_rollback.pointer_switch: second activation records previous index and preserves one pointer row
index_switch_and_rollback.retention: previous active index retention deadline is at least 24 hours

override_conflict.review_to_active: accepted as a new audited version
override_conflict.review_to_discarded: accepted as a new audited version
override_conflict.replacement_content_ref: persisted and retained through state transitions without exposing raw text
